rows.note: Use 估 as the all-purpose everyday way to say that you are guessing or putting forward an unproven idea.

example.english: I conjecture that he won't come today.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gu2 keoi5 gam1 jat6 m4 wui5 lai4

rows.note: Use 猜 when the conjecture is specifically a guess about an answer, result, or hidden fact.

example.english: Who does this key belong to? I conjecture that it belongs to Ming.
example.traditional: 呢條鎖匙係邊個嘅？我猜係阿明嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 so2 si4 hai6 bin1 go3 ge3 ngo5 caai1 hai6 aa3 ming4 ge3

rows.note: Use 推測 for a more reasoned or formal conjecture based on available clues.

example.english: Based on the footprints at the scene, I conjecture that the thief left through the back door.
example.traditional: 根據現場嘅腳印，我推測賊人由後門離開。
example.jyutping: gan1 geoi3 jin6 coeng4 ge3 goek3 jan3 ngo5 teoi1 cak1 caak6 jan4 jau4 hau6 mun4 lei4 hoi1

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for an unproven guess or tentative idea.

example.english: This is just my conjecture; there is no evidence to prove it.
example.traditional: 呢個只係我嘅猜測，未有證據證明。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zi2 hai6 ngo5 ge3 caai1 cak1 mei6 jau5 zing3 geoi3 zing3 ming4

rows.note: Use this specifically for a proposed hypothesis or supposition used as a basis for reasoning.

example.english: Let’s start with this conjecture: if the rent rises again, everyone will move out.
example.traditional: 我哋先作個假設：如果租金再加，大家就會搬走。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 sin1 zok3 go3 gaa2 cit3 jyu4 gwo2 zou1 gam1 zoi3 gaa1 daai6 gaa1 zau6 wui5 bun1 zau2

rows.note: Use this when the conjecture is an inference drawn from incomplete evidence rather than a bare guess.

example.english: Based on the existing data, this conjecture still needs to be verified.
example.traditional: 根據現有數據，呢個推測仍然有待驗證。
example.jyutping: gan1 geoi3 jin6 jau5 sou3 geoi3 ni1 go3 teoi1 cak1 jing4 jin4 jau5 doi6 jim6 zing3
